notes: Version 2.5 aligns the note with TopologicalInvariants 1.2. The winding of the Hopf phase fibre is invariant for configurations in a fixed fibre or over a trivialising domain of the base, not in the whole fibre S^3, so the former statement that the winding result does not use the chosen domain is withdrawn. The identification of the winding with electric charge is not derived and charge quantisation is listed as open. The bibliography carries the new TopologicalInvariants title. No other statement of the note is changed.
